# Tech Whims | 张晓龙 (Xiaolong Zhang)

> Personal blog of Xiaolong Zhang (Allen), a data engineer and technology enthusiast based in China. The site covers big data, data engineering, data lakes, data warehouses, AI/LLM applications, reading notes, and personal growth.

## About the Author

Xiaolong Zhang (张晓龙), also known as Allen, is a senior data engineer with expertise in:
- Big data infrastructure (Spark, Hive, HBase, Elasticsearch)
- Data engineering and data platform architecture
- Data lake technologies (Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake, Apache Hudi)
- AI and LLM applications in production
- Investing and trading systems

## Site Structure

- **Chinese Blog** (主要内容): https://techwhims.com/cn/ - Articles on big data, AI, reading notes, personal growth
- **English Blog**: https://techwhims.com/en/ - English posts on technology and learning
- **AI Diary** (AI日记): https://techwhims.com/ai-diary/ - Daily AI usage notes and experiments
- **About**: https://techwhims.com/cn/about/ - Author background

### Technology
- Big data engineering: Spark, Hive, HBase, data lake architecture

- Book notes on investing, psychology, management, history

- Trading system design
